name: Osa-AK against SEAD hunters: anti-radiation missiles and the drill
description: A fictional SEAD raid (roadmap E6). Two hunters come in high and fire anti-radiation missiles at the vehicle as soon as its radars radiate within their reach; a strike aircraft follows. The senior operator calls an echo that closes faster than any aircraft ('Пуск ПРР!'), the commander has both transmitters off at once ('ПРР! Излучение выключить!') and keeps them off for a while: the first ARM has no memory and loses the radar, or turns onto the decoy emitter at the dummy position, which comes on when the radar goes off; the second remembers for 8 s. Then the radars come on again for the strike aircraft. The NPC commander runs the crew; take any seat, or his.
notes: The drill: samsim_thread (ePap: stop any emission and change position), video_osa (the radar off; unverified); SAM Simulator models Shrike, Standard ARM and HARM (samsim_osa p32). Everything here is a PLACEHOLDER: the hunters' routes, the ARMs' ranges, speeds and memories, the decoy's place. The ARM is a gameplay rule (simcore/scenario_runner.hpp; game values in gameplay/osa_ak.json "arm"), not a seeker model. The hunters carry NATO's class warning receiver (em/nato_1985.json) and jink when warned of a launch.
